title: Meeting a Tight Deadline
paragraphs: Adam receives an urgent request from his manager late on Wednesday afternoon: a full report needs to be finished by Friday morning, which means he must reorganize his entire schedule for the next two days.
He decides to skip a few less important tasks temporarily and focus his energy on the report first, taking short breaks between sections instead of working continuously without stopping to rest.
By Thursday afternoon, he realizes one section requires data from another department, and he has to send a quick message asking a colleague to share the numbers earlier than originally planned.

By Thursday evening, Adam finishes the report a full day earlier than the deadline. He learns that staying calm and prioritizing clearly under pressure works far better than panicking about the tight timeline.
